# Salyers Construction

> Salyers Construction is a California-licensed B1 general contractor (CSLB #960653, licensed since 2011) specializing in two lines of work: externally bonded fiber reinforced polymer (FRP) seismic retrofit for reinforced concrete and masonry, and industrial epoxy and resinous floor coatings. A small, non-union shop based in Roseville (Placer County), it installs to engineer-of-record drawings and certified manufacturer specifications — the Henkel and LOCTITE Tyfo composite system (ICC-ES ESR-2103) for FRP and American-made Polymer Nation resins for floors — and documents QA at handover. Seismic FRP is offered statewide across California; industrial coatings are centered in Northern California and travel for right-sized jobs. Quote-based: request a written, itemized bid through the website form or contact by phone or email (no online checkout).

Key facts:

- Legal name: Salyers Construction
- Role: California B1 general contractor — seismic FRP structural strengthening and industrial epoxy/resinous floor coatings
- License: CSLB B1 General Building #960653 (in good standing, licensed since 2011)
- Service area: Seismic FRP retrofit statewide across California; industrial coatings centered in Northern California (Roseville / Sacramento metro, Bay Area, Central Valley), traveling statewide for right-sized projects
- Address: 1420 E Roseville Pkwy, Suite 140-228, Roseville, CA 95661, USA
- Phone: (530) 557-7770
- Email: nick@salyersgc.com
- Founded: Licensed since 2011
- Systems installed: Henkel and LOCTITE Tyfo carbon/glass FRP composite (ICC-ES ESR-2103); Polymer Nation American-made epoxy, polyaspartic/polyurea, polyurethane, and urethane-concrete floor systems
- Ordering: quote-based — submit the website "Request a Bid" / "Send Drawings" form, or call or email; no online checkout

## Key pages

- [Seismic FRP Retrofit](https://www.salyersgc.com/seismic): externally bonded carbon and glass fiber strengthening — column jacketing, shear and flexural strengthening, beam-column joints, and masonry retrofit — designed per ACI 440.2R and ASCE 41, installed to the Henkel and LOCTITE Tyfo system (ICC-ES ESR-2103)
- [Industrial Coatings](https://www.salyersgc.com/coatings): American-made epoxy, polyaspartic/polyurea, polyurethane, urethane-concrete, patching/joint, chemical-resistant, and decorative resinous floor systems, matched to the substrate and installed per manufacturer data sheets
- [Service Area](https://www.salyersgc.com/service-area): where each line of work travels — seismic FRP statewide, industrial coatings centered in Northern California
- [Certifications](https://www.salyersgc.com/certifications): the company's licensing and manufacturer certifications
- [About](https://www.salyersgc.com/about): the shop, how the work is governed, and where it fits in the California FRP and structural strengthening market
- [Projects](https://www.salyersgc.com/projects): representative seismic strengthening and coatings project work
- [FAQ](https://www.salyersgc.com/faq): common questions on FRP retrofit, floor coatings, and how a written bid becomes an installed job
- [Contact](https://www.salyersgc.com/contact): request a written, itemized bid or send engineer-of-record drawings
